name: Streaming The Dark Side Of Smart Contracts A Contract Theory Perspective 9753E68539
text: The Dark Side of Smart Contracts states that smart contracts may govern transactions more cheaply than traditional contracts, firm hierarchies, and relational contracts. This independently corresponds to Kaal's Coasean account of smart contracts as a lower-cost substitute for firm organization. The proposition is qualified and does not establish minimal costs for transactions of every size or high transaction security.
